name: Outlook
description: Send emails, create calendar events, and reply to Outlook emails through Microsoft Graph.

config_variables.name: MAILBOX_USER
config_variables.label: Mailbox User
config_variables.placeholder: Enter mailbox email or user principal name

tools.name: send_email

tools.name: create_calendar_event
tools.documentation: Create a calendar event with a Teams meeting link and send invites to attendees.

tools.name: reply_to_email
tools.documentation: Reply to an existing Outlook email in the configured mailbox.
